prs.title: feat: add optional MCP tools adapter
prs.decision: Reassessed live repo/docs/issues on 2026-05-20. Not worth starting now: no active requirement for exposing ai_actuary tools through MCP to multiple agent frameworks; implementing MCP now would add dependency/protocol/security surface without a caller.

next_action: No implementation PR needed. Revisit PR7 only if a persistent service/concurrency/health-check deployment requirement appears; revisit PR8 only if multiple agent frameworks need MCP discovery for ai_actuary tools.
codex_review_gate: Codex CLI was blocked across implementation PRs because the ChatGPT account does not support the requested Codex models; independent delegate reviewers were used as substitute review gates.
final_live_recheck: No open ai_actuary or ai_interface PRs; PR #27 remains merged; gh pr checks 27 reports no checks configured; inline comments are the already-handled prior comments; no local crontab/user-systemd/system-systemd timer entry visible for this rollout to remove.

optional_prs_reassessment.conclusion: Do not continue PR7/PR8 now; both remain optional and lack a concrete current requirement.
evidence: PR1-PR6 merged; ai_actuary and ai_interface have no open PRs or open issues requiring HTTP/MCP.

ai_actuary already has FastAPI health/preflight/tools/runs/replay/repeatability/report/review control-plane endpoints, so a single /calculate chainladder HTTP adapter would duplicate a narrower surface.
ai_interface consumes ai_actuary through the CLI pipeline adapter (ai_actuary.cli.v1); no current caller requires a long-lived ai_actuary service for lower startup overhead or concurrency.

ai_interface manifests reserve execution.kind=mcp, but no current MCP caller/request exists for ai_actuary tool discovery; adding an MCP server would introduce protocol/dependency/security surface before demand.
